synthesis.thesis: Conditional on the declared equilibrium architecture and its existence domains, unanimity can favor a privately informed hegemon without exclusive formal proposal power because it removes coalition substitutes for the hegemon's approval; public benchmarks isolate pivotality, private-public differences isolate informational rent, and a separate mandatory agenda stage identifies their interaction within the model.
synthesis.research_question: What happens to a powerful actor's bargaining payoff and informational rent when majority can bypass the only privately informed participant but unanimity makes its approval indispensable, and how does an earlier mandatory proposal opportunity alter that comparison?
synthesis.contribution: The paper reorganizes private information around one informed hegemon and symmetric uninformed weak states, treats the approval rule as an on-off switch for the informed participant, preserves linked type correspondences and empty cells, and derives the agenda decompositions Delta V^A = Delta v^A + Delta IR^A and T_g = D_g + I_g.
synthesis.claim_type: exact formal equilibrium characterization, correspondence-valued comparative claim, and structural within-model contrast

core_claims.text: Majority supplies a substitute for the informed hegemon's vote while unanimity makes that approval an essential input; any payoff ranking is conditional.
The public baseline includes H under Round-1 majority iff o <= 1/m and always prices H at beta o under unanimity.
Terminal majority excludes H; terminal unanimity screens through p* and pools above it.
Round-1 private majority has exact screening, pooling, exclusion, and linked residual cells.
Round-1 private unanimity is empty for 0 < p <= p* within pure ballot strategies and pools above p*.
Baseline payoff and informational-rent contrasts are distinct linked correspondences with conditional signs and propagated emptiness.
Public agenda power can favor either rule; for o > 1/m the public gap has the sign of beta o - e/m.
Private agenda results require complete Borel binders; payoff images, envelopes, and summaries cannot be spliced.
Same-fiber comparison preserves complete records; beta h < e/m is sufficient but not necessary for setwise majority advantage.
Delta V^A = Delta v^A + Delta IR^A member by member; unanimity agenda rent is nonnegative for the low type and nonpositive for the high type in every existing fiber.
T_g = D_g + I_g within the structural factorial design; T_U is weakly positive where both arms exist, while T_M has no general sign and Q_g is not one-factor causal.
The WTO material is a theoretical strategic crosswalk, not literal implementation, calibration, or identification.

Simultaneous public ballots under a fixed majority or unanimity rule
PBE with pure ballot strategies, declared belief/voting disciplines, support-preserving endpoints, and proposal tie-break

Type vectors remain linked and empty sources propagate the empty set
Selection-free signs require the whole exact correspondence on one side of the threshold
